source.title: ITME: Inference Tiered Memory Expansion with Disaggregated CXL-Hybrid Memories
source.summary: Presents ITME, a tiered memory expansion system that exposes a massive TB-scale byte-addressable remote CXL-hybrid memory pool for LLM inference, validated on production SK Hynix CMM hardware and showing up to 35.7% throughput improvement by proactively managing data movement for model weights and prefix caches.
